title: TAS Gate Configuration
description: Declarative Refusal-Parameter contract binding an agent to a principal's verified authority, scope, and temporal constraints.

version.description: Schema version for forward-compatibility. Must follow semver.

principal.description: The verified, cryptographically signed actor who issues this gate configuration.

id.description: A stable, unique identifier for the principal (e.g. DID, UUID, or domain-qualified handle).

public_key.description: Base64url-encoded public key used to verify the principal's signature.

signature.description: Base64url-encoded cryptographic signature over the canonical form of this document (excluding this field). Signing algorithm is determined by the key type.

display_name.description: Human-readable label for the principal. Optional; not used in verification.

scope.description: Explicit enumeration of actions the agent is permitted to attempt. Anything not listed is refused.

permitted_actions.description: Whitelist of action identifiers the agent may execute. Must be non-empty.

denied_actions.description: Explicit deny list that overrides permitted_actions if there is a conflict. Defaults to empty.

resource_patterns.description: Optional glob-style patterns that further restrict which resources the permitted actions apply to.

temporal.description: Tamper-proof time window during which this gate is active. Outside this window every action is refused.

not_before.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp. Actions attempted before this moment are refused.

not_after.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp. Actions attempted at or after this moment are refused.

clock_skew_seconds.description: Maximum tolerated clock skew in seconds when evaluating not_before / not_after. Defaults to 30.

lineage.description: Proof chain tracing this gate back to a Human-in-the-Loop root authority.

root_authority_id.description: Identifier of the Tier-0 human principal who ultimately authorizes this gate.

chain.description: Ordered sequence of delegation receipts from root_authority_id down to the principal. Each entry must be verifiable against its predecessor.

delegator_id.description: The actor granting delegation at this step.

delegatee_id.description: The actor receiving delegation at this step.

receipt_hash.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 (or stronger) hash of the immutable delegation receipt stored on the ledger.

issued_at.description: Timestamp when this delegation was issued.

receipt_policy.description: Controls how execution and refusal receipts are generated and stored. Optional; system defaults apply when omitted.

ledger_endpoint.description: URI of the immutable ledger to which receipts are written.

hash_algorithm.description: Hashing algorithm used to compute receipt hashes. Defaults to SHA-256.

include_input_hash.description: When true, a hash of the action's input payload is embedded in the receipt for evidence-readiness. Defaults to true.

metadata.description: Free-form key/value annotations. Not used in enforcement logic.
